compaction: Original layer defaults/matrices omitted; frame/clip/paint/text/path order retained. Root/children/mask are immutable nodes-array indices, interned bottom-up. Raster descriptors only; bitmap bytes are not duplicated.
limitations: Original model layers and action/clip/scroll geometry. Native font raster, intermediate CoreAnimation pixels and projected editor layout are separate gates.
Media descriptors are inert synthetic references; no thumbnail decode or player is activated.

rasterAssets.role: intrinsic source layer contents; not whole-module rasterization
